title: Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data
summary: A massive data breach in Denmark's CPR (Central Person Register) system resulted in unauthorized access to personal information of 8.8 million people, effectively exposing the entire Danish population's sensitive civil registration data.
problem_solved: This is a news report about a security incident, not a solution - it documents a catastrophic failure of data protection measures.
why_valuable: Highlights critical importance of securing civil registration systems and demonstrates the scale of damage when foundational identity databases are compromised.
